thread:
lina: Quick thread for NimbusGrid + Redwood marketplace launch webinar on Jun 2. Need final confirmation on embargo timing, demo failover, and who signs off on marketplace SKU copy. :speaker_high_volume:

tom: I can own the SKU copy. What's the embargo window? marketing requested T+1 hour after webinar for the announcement. Is that set in stone?

raj: Legal needs 48h for review of joint announcement language. If marketing wants T+1, we need legal reviewed by EOD May 30.

sylvia: FYI NimbusGrid (matt) wants the demo to show "one-click deploy from marketplace" then failover to our hosted fallback if their cluster is busy. Can we script that?

matt (NimbusGrid): yes. We'll prepare a cloud image and a pre-populated template. We'll also provide a short auth token for the demo.

lina: good. Tom, please draft SKU + short blurb: 1-line description, 2 bullets (what it does, ideal customer). Put in the shared doc.

tom: draft done: "NimbusGrid on Redwood: production-ready inference runtime in the marketplace." Put bullets and CTA in the doc: https://docs.google.com/d/1MarketDraft

raj: I left comments on the doc re: IP and citation language. Also add this clause: "Neither party will disclose confidential customer data in the announcement."

sylvia: shipping tech: NimbusGrid will self-host the demo environment. For our fallback we'll use a pre-warmed Redwood Dedicated instance in us-west-2. Need ENSURE we have capacity reservation that morning. ops-bot please confirm.

publish-bot: Ops check scheduled: reserve-capacity --region us-west-2 --units 2 --when 2026-06-02T09:00:00Z

lina: thanks. Also we need a recording release signed by NimbusGrid and a speaker headshot + 1-paragraph bio from Matt by May 28. Matt can you drop those here?

matt (NimbusGrid): dropping bio now: "Matt Reyes, Head of Partnerships @ NimbusGrid. Former infra lead at CloudRun. Loves low-latency inference." Headshot uploaded to shared drive.

raj: legal approves the updated announcement copy. I'm CCing contracts for the joint press LOI.

tom: webinar logistics: 45 min slot. Proposed flow: 8m intros, 15m live deploy demo, 12m customer use case + architecture, 10m panel Q&A. Also plan for Slido for live Qs.

sylvia: for demo fallback we will run a scripted smoke test that deploys the marketplace SKU then runs a small inference job. If the deploy fails, the script will auto-switch to our dedicated instance and run the job. I pushed the script to the repo: https://git.redwood/repo/marketplace-demo/actions/deploy-failover.sh

lina: we need a short 90s pre-recorded clip showing the one-click flow in case live deploy is too slow. Who takes it?

matt (NimbusGrid): NimbusGrid will record the 90s clip and share an MP4 by May 29.

publish-bot: Reminder: embargo metadata required in PR: {"embargo_time":"2026-06-02T10:00:00Z","notify_list":["marketing@redwood.com","press@NimbusGrid.com"]}

raj: small legal ask: add sentence "Customers listed are fictional unless otherwise noted." Avoid real customer names in slides.

tom: tee-shirt ask from events: 150 tees, unisex. Who orders? I can — need size breakdown. Also branded laptop stickers 300.

sylvia: events team: 40 L, 50 M, 40 S, 20 XL. Ship to: Redwood Events, 1200 Mission St, San Francisco. Email ops@redwood.com for courier label.

lina: final action list: Tom 1 SKU + deck bullets (by May 28), Matt 1 bio + headshot + 90s clip (by May 29), Raj 1 legal sign-off on announcement (by May 30), Sylvia/ops 1 reserve capacity + event shipping (by Jun 1). We'll do tech rehearsal Jun 1 10:00am PT. Anyone object?

matt (NimbusGrid): all good from our side. See you at rehearsal. :rocket:
